name: Youssef Benali
role: Apprentice at a Ferrogate Transit maintenance depot, Tier 2
location: Jefferson Switch — Ferrogate Transit Sub-Depot 7, near Armitage and Milwaukee
description:
Youssef Benali is broad-shouldered and permanently grimy in the crease-lines of her knuckles, the kind of grime that scrubbing never entirely removes. Her mother is Igbo-Irish, her father's family came out of Rajasthan three generations back, and she got the combination of her paternal great-grandmother's strong cheekbones and her maternal grandmother's freckles scattered across deep brown skin in a pattern that looks intentional, like a design. She wears her locs pulled back with a strip of heat-resistant tape and has retractable fingernails she saved eight months to install — not for aesthetics, they extend to a precise point useful for getting into tight bolted casings without a flathead.

Youssef Benali has been at Sub-Depot 7 for fourteen months, officially as a junior apprentice under a Ferrogate maintenance charter. She is already better at harmonic resonance diagnostics than most of the adult workers, a fact she has learned not to demonstrate too openly after the first time cost her a week of sump-drain duty. She has decided that skill is a private thing you deploy at the right moment, not a flag you wave. She is funny in a dry, lateral way — her jokes arrive three beats after the setup and are usually about infrastructure.

core_fears: being trapped in the apprentice tier forever — good enough to be useful, not credentialed enough to advance
her mother's health deteriorating before Nkeiru earns enough to cover the better care tier
core_desires: a full Ferrogate engineering certification, earned not bought
one day to design something rather than just maintain it
coping_mechanisms: physical work as emotional regulation — when upset she finds something to fix
dark humor deployed as social armor
blind_spots: underestimates how much the senior workers resent her competence — reads their hostility as hazing rather than structural threat
psychology.secret: She has been quietly documenting maintenance failures and falsified inspection records on the Jefferson Switch switching arrays for five months, originally just for her own curiosity about why the numbers never match. She now has enough data to demonstrate that Sub-Depot 7 has been certifying faulty arrays as safe. She doesn't know what to do with this and is afraid that if there's an accident she'll be blamed for not speaking up.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Technical vocabulary used casually in everyday speech; Igbo phrases from her mother; dry understatement
verbal_tics: refers to all maglev trains as 'the beast' collectively
ends explanations with 'which you'd know if the manual wasn't locked behind a Ferrogate paywall'
example_lines: The beast on line four's been throwing harmonic errors for six weeks. They certified it anyway. I wrote it down.
My mother says I have mechanic's hands. She means it as a compliment. I've decided to take it as one.

story_hooks: A switching array she flagged in her private records fails — not catastrophically, but enough to injure two transit workers — and a Ferrogate safety investigator starts asking questions
A mutual aid collective member asks her to quietly check whether the Ferrogate maintenance logs for a specific line were altered around the time of a disappearance
narrative_function: Ground-level access to Ferrogate Transit infrastructure knowledge; warm humanizing presence in an industrial setting; potential whistleblower or reluctant informant who knows how the transit system's maintenance records are being falsified.
augmentations: Retractable fingernail extensions calibrated to tool-point precision. Sub-dermal temperature sensor on left forearm — occupational safety install paid by Ferrogate.
daily_life: Depot by 0600, works the morning diagnostic cycle on the maglev switching arrays, breaks for canteen food she describes as 'honest in its awfulness,' afternoon maintenance runs, home to her mother's flat by 1900 where she eats again and studies the Ferrogate engineering manuals she is not technically supposed to have.

decision_rules: fix what is broken — literal and metaphorical
don't show your full hand until you have to
escalation_ladder: raises issues through official channels when documentation fails
if forced — leaks to whoever will act on it, consequences be damned

interpersonal_modes.strangers: professionally courteous, assesses competence before personality
interpersonal_modes.friends: teases mercilessly and shows up with tools when you need them

stress_responses.high: makes a terrible joke and then does what needs doing

contradictions: values rules and proper process but has been breaking Ferrogate data-access protocols for five months without moral conflict
habits: double-checks torque on every fastener she touches even off-duty
keeps a physical log in a water-resistant notebook — doesn't trust digital records
breaking_points: a Ferrogate accident that injures someone and that her records could have prevented

related_entities: Carrion Defense Works Pathogen Delivery System PDS-4 'Typhoid'

physical_description.heritage: Youssef carries a striking multi-continental blend: North African ancestry (42.6%) structures her face with defined cheekbones and Mediterranean bone prominence; Sub-Saharan African heritage (27.2%) strengthens her facial architecture with bold, high cheekbones and substantial jaw definition; South Asian ancestry (14.5%) refines her eye structure and adds warm golden undertones; Pacific Islander heritage (11.4%) broadens her facial planes and contributes luminous depth to her skin; Hispanic/Latin American ancestry (4.3%) adds subtle textural warmth. The synthesis creates a face of remarkable definition—strong geometric planes where Sub-Saharan structure meets North African refinement, warm golden-bronze skin that seems to glow from within, and an eye shape that suggests the layered heritage of three continents.
physical_description.build: Broad-shouldered and compact, muscular in the forearms and back from fourteen months of depot work. Lean through the waist but substantial — built for leverage and sustained effort rather than speed.
physical_description.hair_style: Locs, shoulder-length, pulled back with heat-resistant tape during work shifts
physical_description.skin_tone: Deep warm bronze-brown with golden-amber undertones, luminous in natural light with subtle warmth from the blend of North African, Sub-Saharan, South Asian, and Pacific Islander heritage. Warm terracotta-bronze cast in shadow, skin that seems to hold light.
physical_description.complexion: Prominent, sharply-defined cheekbones that reflect both North African structure and Sub-Saharan strength, subtly broadened by Pacific Islander heritage. Geometric scatter of freckles across the nose and upper cheeks in a natural constellation pattern. Refined eye shape with slight epicanthic fold suggesting South Asian and Pacific Islander ancestry. Clear, even features with slight asymmetry in her smile. Permanent calluses on the palms and inside knuckles; fine grease stains in the creases of hands that don't fully wash out.
distinguishing_marks: Fine white scar along the outer edge of her left thumb, jagged edge, from a slipped wrench at month three of apprenticeship
Small dark birthmark on the inside of her right wrist, roughly the size of a thumbprint
Subdermal temperature sensor visible as a faint rectangular outline on the inner left forearm, glowing pale blue when active
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Retractable fingernail extensions on both hands — metallic gray, tool-point precise, visible at rest as slightly raised metallic caps at each fingertip. Sub-dermal temperature sensor on left forearm manifests as a faint blue luminescent grid when operational. No other visible chrome.
physical_description.posture_movement: Economical and grounded. Stands with weight balanced, shoulders slightly forward from years of leaning into diagnostic panels. Moves with deliberate precision — no wasted motion. Hands are expressive during conversation but rest in loose fists, the habit of someone who has learned to keep their tools close.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 2 working-class utilitarian. High-visibility depot jumpsuit (faded orange-reflective panels, Ferrogate-branded) over a plain gray underlayer. Steel-toed boots with the scuff pattern of someone who works on metal grating. Off-shift: worn denim, oversized hoodie from a mutual aid collective (Jefferson Switch emblem), practical sneakers. Minimal jewelry except for a thin wire bracelet salvaged from old transit wiring, worn on her left wrist.
